title: WeChat: connection, commerce and the cost of overload
teamMetadataProvenance: Names, leadership and teacher permission for a four-person group are user-supplied course metadata, not findings from the cited papers.

tencent.metric: Combined monthly active user accounts of Weixin and WeChat
tencent.caveat: Accounts, not distinct people; Weixin and WeChat combined. Latest interim observation is separate from the year-end series.

commerce.population: Chinese WeChat shoppers recruited through Sojump; 574 responses, 514 valid questionnaires
commerce.caveat: Cross-sectional self-report; intention is not observed purchasing. Table 4 r values and Figure 2 standardized beta coefficients are different metrics.

connection.collection: January–May 2020; two waves three months apart in China
connection.caveat: Standardized cross-lagged model paths; perceived social capital, not contact counts. Observational panel; prior levels and selected covariates do not establish causation. All eight paths shown.

fatigue.collection: January–February 2024; Credamo online panel of Chinese WeChat users
fatigue.caveat: Standardized SEM paths, all shown paths p < .01; cross-sectional self-report, not causal effects. Time shares describe this sample only; bin labels follow the original table.
